title: Ilizwi kwiSandwithi yamandulo
intro: Phakathi kwabathunywa bokuqala baka-Allah, kwakukho omnye ogama lakhe likhanya kancinci kodwa linentsingiselo kwiQuran. Lo mntu waphila ixesha elide ngaphambi kokuba kuthunyelwe abaprofeti abaninzi abakhulu, kwaye wayesaziwa ngokunyaniseka okungagungqiyo nomonde. Ibali labo lifutshane kodwa ilifa labo lihlala likho kwirekhodi engunaphakade. Ngubani lo mphefumlo uhloniphekileyo?
clues: Ndingomnye wabathunywa bokuqala, abakhankanywa kafutshane kodwa banentsingiselo kwiQuran.
Ubuntu bam buchazwe kukuzinikela okungagungqiyo kwinyaniso.
Ndikhunjulwa kwincwadi ka-Allah phakathi kwabo babeqinile kwaye benomonde.
Zimbalwa iivesi ezimfutshane kwiQuran ezibalisa ibali lam.
U-Allah undihloniphile ngendlela eyam yodwa, engeyiyo eyabanye abaprofeti.
Ndikhuliswe kwisikhundla esiphezulu, imbeko ekhethekileyo kwiQuran.

verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
